row.evidence: Qualified's trust page says SAML SSO is a standard feature on its Enterprise plan with Okta, Azure and OneLogin; Qualified's own pages never mention SCIM, and the only provisioning evidence is the Okta OIN app's SCIM Create/Update/Deactivate ticks.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: the pricing page sells Piper the AI SDR Agent in Premier, Enterprise and Ultimate packages, all 'Contact us', sized by web sessions and email contacts rather than seats. SAML SSO is standard on Enterprise (trust page), so sso_plan is Enterprise. Status is unknown under rule 6a: the Okta OIN 'Qualified' app ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate, but Qualified publishes no SCIM documentation (its help docs under app.qualified.com/docs require login), so the SCIM plan cannot be confirmed from a vendor page. The public Qualified Enterprise API (Enterprise plan: 'MCP and API access') covers leads, companies, sessions, conversations, messages, meetings and emails, with no user or seat endpoints.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Includes 1 SDR agent profile, 250K monthly web sessions, 2.5K monthly active email contacts.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds agent handoff, MCP and API access, Salesforce sandbox. The API has no user-management endpoints.

scim.notes: Qualified's own pages do not mention SCIM. The Okta OIN app lists SCIM Create, Update and Deactivate (see idp_apps.okta); per rule 6a that alone keeps the row unknown.

rate_limits.text: Per team: 10 concurrent requests, 2,000 per 15 minutes, 7,000 per hour, 120,000 per day.

user_api.notes: The Qualified Enterprise API is a data API (leads, companies, bulk, sessions, conversations, messages, meetings, emails, meeting cancel, GDPR deletion) with no user, seat or role endpoints; available=false refers to user management only.

okta.notes: OIN functionality filters ticked: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (last updated May 7 2021). Who built the connector is not stated.

entra.notes: Qualified names Azure as a supported SAML IdP; no Entra gallery tutorial found (qualified-tutorial returns 404).

onelogin.notes: Qualified names OneLogin as a supported SAML IdP.

fallbacks.notes: The API reference is public; the in-app help docs under app.qualified.com/docs return 401 without login, and no public SCIM guide exists.
